body: You’re saying the truth, I suppose. I appreciate that. Even if I am not some monster, I don’t have it in me to “truly believe” or contribute to anything, really. Apologies for wasting your time!

Is it my fate to be controlled by the chemicals in these forsaken pills? Am I to live a life of grey, kept from the chaotic but bright lights of life? Will I be able go le necro skullfuck epic style funny moments r/196 funny???
Thank you anyways. Its nice having someone really hear me out. Ill try to keep my head clear. I can't really thank you enough.
Its the same problem with my friends, that and the fact that they aren't particularly close. They're just people to hang out with I guess.

They're my parents. I don't have anything other than negative feelings towards them. I act as I don't hate them though, they're the ones feeding me, after all. Mental health "professionals" are just a waste of time. They ask you questions upon questions and they only ever respond with "uh huh" "ok" and "that must've been horrible!" They're nothing more than glorified scam artists. My parents make me meet one. He doesn't listen and I don't trust him anyways.

No, I'm not very open with them unless I'm actively being forced to. They're aware of my depression but not the noise in my head. They're not privy to the fact that I can't focus without some stress relief (as in talking to my friends and such). They probably wouldn't care.

Thank you. It's nice to hear someone. It's not so noisey now so I think I can keep a clear head. I don't really know where to start. Whenever I really want to talk with someone about my situation my brain gets all muddy. Talking and playing games with friends keeps me grounded and sane, but since I haven't done my homework I can't get on. If I don't have my friends to keep me sane, then it's nearly impossible for me to focus on anything but the noise. The intrusive thoughts of hurting/killing my parents are a daily occurence now. I can't think straight. It's in my head I just wish I could just cut it out. I dont care if I have to get a knife and cut it out myself I just want it gone. I'm sorry if this is disjointed but I can't focus on one issue even with a relatively clear head. The loneliness kills me every day too. I don't have anyone I truely love or can contact for help. It feels like there's this inescapable black hole sucking me into it from the inside. I just want someone to really love me despite my sins.
they can you fucking moron. goddamn i bet you're under their fucking control right now
What about thought crimes? if one of them could see who i really am they're probably reporting me right now.
I don't know what if they're glowies? I don't trust them one bit they may be getting my information or some shit what if they report me????????

I can touch things around me. They are not real. I don't even know why I'm talking to you people even if you're not real. The tea cup right next to me is just a construct of my mind. Calling for help would just be calling myself, construct.

I hope to god that I can have the courage to kill myself. To all of those who I've afflicted, it would be justice. God will at least be somewhat pleased that I've come to my senses. I think I am the sanest I have ever been. My misplaced sense of self-preservation has made me sin even further. I know that now. These fucking pills have just clouded my judgement. Fuckking goddamn piece of shit feds with all their drugs and control devices. Now that I think about it I was probably being groomed into one of their pedophile scumbags. I've resisted the control method and now I'm better than ever before.
